lastCompletedStory.title: Best-effort Resend escalation + plan_approval/Resend config surface + runbook

nextStoryContext: US-007 adds: (1) src/notify/resend.ts: best-effort Resend client with injectable sendFn, sendEscalation() never throws; (2) loop.ts RunSupervisorOptions gains escalateFn?: () => Promise<void>, called best-effort in the MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT terminal block; (3) src/config/models.ts gains readResendConfig() reading [notify] resend_api_key + resend_recipient; (4) setup.ts/config.ts gain plan_approval and Resend config surface (planApproval field in SetupOptions, SetupAnswers, ParsedSetupArgs with --plan-approval flag; resendApiKey/resendRecipient in SetupOptions with --resend-api-key/--resend-recipient flags); (5) SetupScreen.tsx and ConfigScreen.tsx add a plan-approval Select step; (6) warnIfResendUnconfigured() exported helper warns when plan_approval=auto and resend unconfigured; (7) docs/recovery-runbook.md section (v) documents the auto pipeline + non-convergence escalation scenario. The resend package v6.16.0 is installed in package.json. Production wiring of escalateFn in host.ts (reading resendConfig and building the escalation call) is NOT yet done -- the sidecar does not yet auto-wire Resend escalations in production; tests only exercise the injectable seam.

officialDocsValidated.summary: v6 API confirmed: import { Resend } from 'resend'; new Resend(apiKey); await r.emails.send({from,to,subject,html}) returns {data,error} (discriminated union, never throws on API errors but can throw on network errors). Implementation matches.
